sourceQuote: The Winter Deer Season in zone 13 and 14 is open January 1 – February 13, 2027. | Licensed hunters may use archery equipment or primitive firearms during the winter deer season; no archery or primitive stamps are needed. | You can get one free Winter Deer Permit*, which allows you to take 1 additional deer of either sex to be used only during the Winter Deer Season in zones 13 and 14 only.
notes: Archery or primitive firearms only; 2027 hunting or sporting license required (on sale Dec. 1, 2026). Unlimited 2027 antlerless permits for Zones 13 and 14. 500 square inches of blaze orange required. Years as printed in the source.
